items.reason: A gentle, fragrance-free style cleanser keeps an oily-looking T-zone feeling fresh without stripping.
A light mattifying gel moisturizer adds hydration while keeping shine in check.
Daily mineral SPF 50 is the most useful habit for keeping skin looking its best long term.

response.routine_note: We left out the Vitamin C serum and Peptide Firming Cream because anti-aging products are not designed for skin at 15, and your scan shows nothing that calls for them. Cleanse and moisturize morning and night, and wear sunscreen every morning; if you have worries about your skin, a dermatologist or pharmacist is a good person to ask.
